literature.single_site_literature_target_note: Published amplitude and reversibility screen at matched18s duration;2SEM acceptance and1mV recovery threshold are adopted design constraints, not raw-data likelihood. Exposure connected exposure footprint16cells is a structural assumption, with8cell sensitivity also evaluated. No latency calibration or external validation.

calibration.footprint_shape: BFS-connected left distal subtree; selected16-cell structural assumption shared by every model
calibration.nominal_selection: closest to published mean among reversible18s-screen accepted draws; no paired response used
calibration.single_trace_provenance: synthetic nominal model; twelve local protocols plus connected broad exposure on T1 only; every fifth10ms sample in local traces

passive.objective: single-site weak traces plus broad18s endpoint and5s recovery; each anchor weighted10, same bounds and three starts

sensor_only.objective: single-site weak traces plus broad18s endpoint and5s recovery; each anchor weighted10, same bounds and three starts

capillary_linear.objective: single-site weak traces plus broad18s endpoint and5s recovery; each anchor weighted10, same bounds and three starts

arteriole_linear.objective: single-site weak traces plus broad18s endpoint and5s recovery; each anchor weighted10, same bounds and three starts

dynamic_filter.input: passive cable fitted on the same singleton targets, frozen before fitting the pooled filter; no paired observations

independent_sensors.privilege: exact single-site waveform for every tested site, including held-out topology; no paired trace

screen_diagnostics.persistence_definition: residual hyperpolarization at 5 s after offset; this finite observation alone does not demonstrate permanent latching

identifiability.meaning: finite-design local sensitivity and tolerance set, neither posterior probability nor population confidence interval

concentration_boundary.interpretation: finite nominal sweep; sign brackets are sampled, not exact bifurcation boundaries. The 9 to 10.5 mM band is a conditional concentration-tolerance diagnostic, not a physiological safety range.

pooled_null_precision.meaning: worst sampled distributed contrast against exact pooled-input zero; no rival parameter envelope is needed for an invariant null
worst sampled distributed contrast against exact pooled-input zero; no rival parameter envelope is needed for an invariant null

pharmacology_precision.assumption: eight independent means for drug-minus-control geometry residual; idealized block and predeclared nominal design

precision.assumption: H_AB-H_AC-H_B+H_C uses four independent condition means; the common H_A cancels. If singleton equality is known exactly, H_AB-H_AC has only two mean errors. The primary calculation retains uncertainty from measured singles. Repeated frames are not independent replicates; prespecified design/window, normal approximation

design.selection: nominal-grid maximum minimum absolute geometry-contrast gap from nondistributed controls; exact pooled-input null is the precision target. Distal-active and arteriole-linear retain distributed Kir and fail broad singleton calibration, so their parameter-sensitive differences are localization diagnostics, excluded from design optimization. Equal-depth sibling vs distant T1 tips; no experimental outcomes observed

katp_scenario.interpretation: assumed effective capillary-node KATP input; no explicit pericyte compartment or metabolic kinetics

resetting.mechanism: Imposed receptor-associated exponential Kir suppression and complementary ohmic depolarizing conductance; no identified potassium-to-PIP2 feedback law.
resetting.assumptions: Receptor drive coincides with potassium exposure. Modulation recovers exponentially after removal. Rates, maximum depolarizing conductance, reversal, and spatial scope are design sensitivities, not fitted physiological values. Arteriolar membranes are unchanged.

parameter_provenance.purpose: Frozen parameter provenance for a literature-constrained synthetic paired-input discrimination study; not an empirical fitted dataset.

c_cap_pf.locator: Results, Modeling cEC Electrophysiology; paragraph following Fig. 2F
c_cap_pf.note: Mean isolated capillary endothelial cell capacitance; held constant here, not a known value for every cell.

c_pa_unit_pf.note: Published effective pair capacitance; three equal pairs are lumped at each axial node.

g_kir_coefficient_measured.note: Coefficient Gbar, not conductance G at resting K. Published plus/minus is biological sample spread; not a fitted uncertainty interval for this network.

g_bg_measured.note: Sample of isolated capillary endothelial cells.

g_kir_bounds.note: Subset of published model explorations. G=Gbar*sqrt(3); upper end is not a measured population confidence bound.

g_bg_bounds.note: Chosen interval around measured mean 0.06 and spread 0.04; not a probability distribution or confidence interval.

r_gj_bounds_mohm.note: Capillary junctional resistance was explicitly unmeasured. Published model explored 10 to 1000 MOhm. This study uses a bounded subset, not an experimentally identified interval.

r_gj_pa_mohm.locator: Official source scripts/Fig4/Fig4C.m, Gap junctional resistance; Discussion
r_gj_pa_mohm.note: Effective endothelial coupling in arteriole. Lumping three parallel units multiplies axial conductance by three.

g_kir_pa_ns.units: nS at extracellular K=3 mM per EC-SMC unit
g_kir_pa_ns.locator: Official source scripts/Fig4/Fig4C.m, KIR CHANNEL CHARACTERISTICS; main-text Fig. 6 control
g_kir_pa_ns.note: Effective pair Kir conductance, not isolated capillary conductance.

g_bg_pa_ns.locator: Fig. 4F; official source Fig4C.m, BACKGROUND CURRENT
g_bg_pa_ns.note: Fixed arteriole load shared across mechanisms.

e_bg_mv.locator: Methods, Single cEC Electrophysiology; official Fig4C.m
e_bg_mv.note: Same background reversal for capillary and arteriole in reduced model. Actual resting voltage is solved with Kir and network loads present.

dv_kir_mv.note: Half-inactivation offset relative to EK; main text explicitly notes wide uncertainty in offset estimates. Fixed value is a structural assumption limiting the ensemble.

k_kir_mv.note: Rectification slope factor; instantaneous activation approximation.

temperature_k.note: Room-temperature model constant. Predictions do not incorporate body-temperature channel kinetics; not a calibrated in-vivo timing model.

r_gas.note: Unit convention yields RT/F in millivolts.

k_intracellular_mm.note: Fixed ionic reservoir; concentration depletion and pumps are omitted.

k_rest_mm.note: Uniform resting extracellular K; spatial diffusion of injected K is not modeled.

cell_length_um.note: Published capillary cell length. Fig. 4 uses a 200-um arteriole represented by ten axial positions; reconstructed larger networks instead use approximately 33-um arteriolar ECs.

pa_units_per_node.locator: Methods, Multicellular Models; Fig4C.m axial/circumferential arrangement
pa_units_per_node.note: Three circumferential units are assumed isopotential and summed.

geometry.locator: Fig. 4 motivates finite branched preparation; Longden2017 Fig. 2A for magnitude check
geometry.note: Idealized binary tree, two-tree and loop variants are generated, not reconstructions of observed vascular topology. Closed terminal boundaries omit surrounding vascular load.

single_site_reference_voltage.locator: Results, Elevation of K+ around capillaries evokes retrograde electrical signaling; Fig. 2G-H
single_site_reference_voltage.note: Longden measured response to 10mM capillary K roughly500um distant with18s stimulation. The model matches duration and screens response magnitude and recovery; its plume footprint and idealized topology remain assumptions, so this is not a likelihood for raw experimental data.

single_site_reference_latency.note: Observed onset latency not used to claim calibrated timing in this reduced model.

physiological_screen.note: Halfwidth is twice reported SEM, an adopted tolerance rather than a population confidence interval. The primary16cell exposure is one connected capillary patch grown breadth first within a distal subtree, excluding the proximal common trunk. An8cell connected footprint tests structural sensitivity. Experimental plume coverage was not measured. Both amplitudes and recovery are checked before any paired trials are considered.

paired_protocol.locator: Methods in-vivo200–300ms ejection and ex-vivo18s exposure provide scale context only
paired_protocol.note: These exact combinations are newly proposed simulation protocols; no claim that a physiological distribution has been measured.

diameter_transform.locator: Fig. 2 near-maximal dilation around -56mV; in-vivo Fig. 4 mean dilation32.9 percent as scale check only
diameter_transform.note: D/D0=1+0.3*tanh(max(H,0)/10); Q/Q0=(D/D0)^4. Fixed across all models. Fourth-power law assumes fixed pressure, length, viscosity and a single resistance vessel; it is not a prediction of whole-network RBC flow. No readout parameters fitted to pairs.

katp_effective_input_ns.locator: Results, A Mouse Model to Study Pericyte Electrical Signaling
katp_effective_input_ns.note: Effective ohmic hyperpolarizing conductance applied to2cells for a single tip or4cells across a pair, zero elsewhere; near resting voltage gives order7pA/cell. Isaacs measured ArchT7.6±1.3pA, not this KATP conductance. No explicit pericyte-EC junction or ATP/glucose kinetics are inferred.

archt_reference_current_pa.locator: Results, A Mouse Model to Study Pericyte Electrical Signaling
archt_reference_current_pa.note: Pericyte ArchT is a proton pump; comparison gives input-current order of magnitude only.

passive_slope_floor_ns.note: Linearized membranes retain basal current and the resting tangent, clipped to a small positive conductance so the passive counterfactual cannot retain negative-resistance regeneration. This is not a measured capillary conductance.

rest_current_balance_tolerance.note: Depolarized-start integration continues until all nodes satisfy current balance. This prevents incomplete burn-in from creating a spurious passive interaction residual.

primary_step_ms.note: Uniform for all calibration screening and primary predictions. Selected traces, geometry contrasts and pharmacological differences are checked with smaller steps.

pharmacology_block.units: fraction of Kir conductance and model node IDs
pharmacology_block.locator: Kir pharmacology in Fig.2 supports intervention class, not selectivity of this idealized block
pharmacology_block.note: Ideal90percent Kir reduction only in the unstimulated common trunk. Rebaseline and remeasure singles under block. Actual drug spread and off-target actions are not modeled.

value.driver: single-site-fitted passive cable, parameters frozen before filter fitting

dynamic_filter.note: tau*y_dot=-y+a*tanh(x/s). Bounded pooled nonlinearity with a time constant no shorter than the 10ms recording interval. Driver is calibrated using singles, then frozen; its three fitted parameters are additional to the three filter coefficients. No paired responses used in either stage.

precision_assumptions.note: Four independently estimated condition means for the singleton-corrected sibling-minus-distant residual, normal approximation against the pooled-controller zero. The 1mV trial standard deviation is a planning assumption. Localization variants retaining distributed capillary dynamics are descriptive controls and do not set design or sample size. Repeated frames are not independent observations.

slow_reset_sensitivity.locator: Results, reciprocal channel regulation; Fig. 6C; Moshkforoush2020 Methods, Modulation of Kir and TRPV4 Currents by PIP2
slow_reset_sensitivity.note: Harraz PGE2 experiments report 6.4min Kir suppression and 4.9min TRPV4 recruitment under pharmacological, room-temperature conditions. Applying those rates to a receptor drive assumed to coincide with K exposure is a transfer assumption. The extra 1min rate, recovery rate, ohmic TRPV4 surrogate, amplitudes and spatial scope are design choices; no K-triggered biochemical law or body-temperature kinetics are identified. Full grid and refinement are in resetting_study.py.

general_limits: Fixed membrane constants and homogeneous cells do not represent full biological parameter uncertainty.
Capillary coupling remains unmeasured; selected bounds and synthetic calibration cannot establish the intact-brain regime.
Voltage-dependent physiological input currents can interact through source loading even with passive remote propagation.
Global Kir blockade can change local sensing, propagation and arteriolar readout; simulated ideal selective ablations do not assert pharmacological selectivity.
Measurement-noise assumptions, pulse timing, topology, selection thresholds and rival fit bounds are design choices stated in executable analysis, not published measured values.
